results.title: France starts tests on Tesla's self-driving tech
results.description: PARIS, Sept 3 (Reuters) - ⁠France has begun tests on two cars to better assess Tesla's FSD ⁠advanced driver assistance system, French Minister of Transport Philippe Tabarot said, ‌in a move that could bring Europe a step closer to approval of Elon Musk's autonomous driving technology.
